description: Codex adapter: install to .codex/hooks.json (project) or ~/.codex/hooks.json (user). Wires the same harness-neutral scripts templates/harness/claude-code/settings.json wires for Claude Code: SessionStart runs tools/bootstrap.sh, PreToolUse on Bash runs the Markdown gate before a git commit and the push check before a git push, and Stop refuses to end a turn with uncommitted, untracked or unpushed work. The scripts are the claude-code adapter's own .claude/hooks/*.sh, so that directory must be installed too. Codex sets no project-directory variable for a hooks.json hook (it runs it in the session's working directory), so each command finds the repository root itself and passes it on as CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, the variable the scripts read. Codex runs a project hook only once it is trusted, so trust these after installing them. Written 2026-09-28 against the openai/codex source (codex-rs/hooks, codex-rs/config/src/hook_config.rs at main 46fdd5e); not yet seen to fire in a real Codex session -- templates/harness/codex/README.md says what was checked and what was not. This file allows only two top-level keys, description and hooks: Codex parses it with deny_unknown_fields, so a _comment key would make it reject the whole file.
